title: Embedding Space Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Prompt Engineering
description: A two-dimensional map of text embeddings where semantically similar phrases cluster together, with a search box that plots your own query and draws dashed lines to its three nearest neighbors.

learningObjectives: Explain how text embeddings represent semantic meaning as positions in a vector space
Predict which phrases will be retrieved for a given query based on distance in embedding space
prerequisites: Basic idea of a coordinate plane

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Spatial analogy - learners see meaning as distance, then test it by placing their own query into the space
keyQuestions: Why do 'neural networks' and 'deep learning algorithms' sit close together when they share no words?
What happens to retrieval when a query lands between two clusters?
commonMisconceptions: Believing embedding similarity is keyword matching
Believing real embeddings have only two dimensions rather than hundreds or thousands
Believing the nearest neighbor is always a correct or useful answer
assessmentOpportunities: Predict the cluster a new query will land in before searching
Explain why a deliberately ambiguous query produces poor neighbors
